description:
Tap Kilo using any free method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and putting a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

uses.name: Gemstone Array
uses.cardState: with a charge counter on it
